posts.title: Glamorous Christmas: Bringing Charm to Ruby
posts.description: Today, Ruby 4.0 was released . What an exciting milestone for the language! This release brings some amazing new features like the experimental Ruby::Box isolation mechanism, the new ZJIT compiler, significant performance improvements for class instantiation, and promotions of Set and Pathname to core classes. posts.title: Giving Back to the Rails Community
posts.description: I’m deeply grateful and truly honored to be named a Rails Luminary this year. Thank you to everyone who supported me, my work, and took the time to nominate me. Recognition like this only exists because of a community that cares about long-term contribution, and I don’t take that lightly. Rails has given me a lot over the years.
